newsitem.title: CHINA: China cigarette tops domestic brand value.
newsitem.headline: China cigarette tops domestic brand value.

text.p: The brand name value of China's best selling cigarette, Hongtashan, rose to 33.2 billion yuan ($4 billion) in 1996 from 32 billion yuan in 1995, according to a survey published in the Economic Daily on Monday.
The Hongtashan brand, which means Red Pagoda Mountain, was the most valuable among the top 60 domestic brands evaluated by a Beijing assessment agency last year, the newspaper said.
The brand name of Sichuan Changhong Electric Appliances Co Ltd was worth 12.208 billion yuan while in third place was Qingdao Haier Refrigerator Co Ltd, worth 7.736 billion yuan, it said.
The 60 domestic brands included Inner Mongolia Erdos Products Co Ltd, worth 2.166 billion yuan, and China Jialing Industry Co Ltd, with a brand value of 2.73 billion yuan, it said.
The average annual sales of the 60 top brands was 2.588 billion yuan in 1996, up 31 percent from 1995, it said but gave no further details.
